messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['We were unable to process your most recent payment.', 'Your access to our Internet Banking has been temporarily disabled due to multiple login errors.', 'Our records indicate that your AOL mail account is out of date.', 'The current status of the above-mentioned transfer is: failed due to the system malfunctioning.', 'The password for your PayPal has been successfully reset.', 'Access To Your Account Is Currently Unavailable.', 'In my department we discovered an abandoned sum of$15m US dollars (FIFTEEN MILLIONS US DOLLARS).', 'A recent review of your transaction history determined that your card was used at an ATM located in Italy, but for security reasons the requested transaction was refused.', 'Your Barclays internet banking access has been suspended.', 'We recently noticed the following issue on your account:Unusual account activity has made it necessary to limit sensitive account features until additional verification information can be collected!.', 'Due to several failed attempts to access to your account, we temporarily deactivated your online-access for your account for security reasons.', 'We detected irregular activity on your Halifax Card, so we have currently suspended your online account.', 'HSBC has suspended your account profile.', 'Our system detected unusual charges to a credit card linked to your PayPal account.', 'Your account access has been limited for the following reason(s): We have reason to believe that your account was accessed by a third party.', 'As a courtesy and for your safety, eBay notifies you whenever your credit card is used for certain activities on the site.', 'We have noticed that some data from your account information seems inaccurate or unverified.', 'Your access to Online Banking Service has been suspended.', 'Your estimated delivery date is: Tuesday, December 31, 2011']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
